```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dwd_advertise_tracking_item_hi__reg_s0_live
  PARTITION (grass_region, grass_date, h, bz_type)
SELECT
    userid AS user_id,
    sessionid AS session_id,
    item.itemid AS item_id,
    item.shopid AS shop_id,
    item.adsid AS ads_id,
    item.campaignid AS campaign_id,
    item.internal.deduction_info.quality,
    CAST(item.internal.deduction_info.bidprice/100000 AS decimal(25,10)) AS bidprice,
    CAST(item.internal.deduction_info.deduction_price/100000 AS decimal(25,10)) AS deduction_price,
    get_json_object(item.json_data, '$.pricing_type') AS pricing_type,
    -- ... 50+ fields extracted from nested structs ...
    IF(COALESCE(placement, 0) IN (0, 29), 'Search', 'Discovery') AS bz_type
FROM mkplpaidads_data.ods_log_ads_tracking_hi__reg_s0_live
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(items) AS item
WHERE grass_date = '${TODAY_DATE}'
  AND h = ${TODAY_HOUR}
  AND item.itemid > 0;
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

This is an **ODS (Operational Data Store)** table. Data is ingested from the ads tracking SDK directly into HDFS Parquet files, not produced by an INSERT OVERWRITE SQL workflow.

- **Data Source:** Ads tracking SDK client events -> HDFS Parquet ingestion
- **HDFS Path:** `hdfs://R2/projects/mkplpaidads_data/hdfs/prod/operation_data/ads_tracking_parquet`
- **Partition Strategy:** `ADD PARTITION` per `(grass_region, grass_date, h)` - no SQL INSERT; partitions are registered via `ALTER TABLE ADD PARTITION` or `MSCK REPAIR TABLE`
- **Workflow Paths:**
  - `mkplpaidads_data/workflows/data_warehouse/ods/ods_log_ads_tracking_hi__reg_s0_live/` - ADD PARTITION (11 regions)
  - `mkplpaidads_data/workflows/data_warehouse_v1/ods/ods_log_ads_tracking__reg_s0_live/` - CREATE TABLE + ADD PARTITION
  - `data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse_us/ods/ods_log_ads_tracking_hi__reg_s0_live/` - US regions (MX, CO, CL)
